test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 1: Teacher Initializes and Sets Up the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Logout from Course Details Page
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with a pre-provisioned account is logged into the system and is currently on the 'Course Details Page'. The teacher has successfully created a course, updated its information, added a session, and uploaded course materials.
test_cases.expected_result: Upon successful logout, the user's session is terminated and the Teacher is redirected to the 'Landing Page'.
test_cases.post_condition: The Teacher is logged out of the system, and their session is terminated. The user is on the 'Landing Page'.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Logout' button in the navigation bar.
